card_repeatability.title: Does it repeat?
card_repeatability.what_it_tests: Whether a pitcher's score is stable year-to-year (not just noise).
card_repeatability.yoy_lopo_r_note: Leave-one-pitcher-out: model never trained on the scored pitcher's own data
card_repeatability.yoy_loso_mean_r_note: Leave-one-season-out: model sees pitcher in other seasons but not target season
card_repeatability.yoy_insample_r_note: In-sample: live model trained on all seasons including the scored ones
card_repeatability.split_half_note: Not stored as a named artifact. Docstring in analytics/stuff_model.py line 218 reports r=0.98+ even at n=20 (computed during development).
card_repeatability.verdict_note: Physical pitch characteristics repeat reliably. LOPO r=0.558 is the honest out-of-sample figure.

card_predictive.title: Does it predict results?
card_predictive.what_it_tests: Does 2024 Stuff+ v3 predict real 2025 outcomes (strict out-of-sample)?
card_predictive.model_note: Does each pitcher's 2024 Stuff+ v3 predict their real 2025 results? Scored by a model trained on every season EXCEPT 2024 (honest out-of-sample - the live site's model, unlike this one, is trained on all seasons including this one).
card_predictive.direction_note: Negative xwoba correlation is correct: lower xwoba (fewer runs allowed) goes with higher Stuff+.
card_predictive.verdict_note: xwoba r=-0.365, whiff% r=0.420, SwStr% r=0.434 at min 200 pitches (out-of-sample).

card_independence.title: Is it its own thing?
card_independence.what_it_tests: Correlation with the other three models — are they measuring different things?
card_independence.r_deception_note: Pearson r across 2868 pitcher-seasons 2021-2025. Moderate — some shared signal (good pitchers score well on all dimensions) but not redundant.
card_independence.r_tunneling_note: Not yet computed for v2 tunneling vs v3 stuff in a stored artifact.
card_independence.r_location_note: Not yet computed in a stored artifact.
card_independence.verdict_note: Deception+ correlation r=0.396 is moderate and expected. Tunneling+ and Location+ cross-correlations not yet stored as artifacts.

card_stress.title: Stress test
card_stress.what_it_tests: Pitcher-holdout identifiability: can the model's feature vector identify which pitcher it scored?
card_stress.top1_lift_note: Lift over naive baseline at 1 pitcher. Below 1x = model cannot identify pitchers above chance. 0.88x here.
card_stress.verdict_note: Feature vector is only weakly identifiable (top-1 lift 0.88x). LOPO YoY r drops 0.287 below LOSO, consistent with some memorization but not strong. Weight of evidence: genuine generalization with minor memorization.

card_repeatability.title: Does it repeat?
card_repeatability.what_it_tests: Whether a pitcher's command score is stable year-to-year and within-season.
card_repeatability.note: Split-half Spearman-Brown corrected r=0.815 at ≥300 pitches per half. YoY pooled r=0.659 (excl. 2020 pairs). Location+ stabilizes much more slowly than Stuff+ — 300 pitches is the v3 qualification threshold.
card_repeatability.verdict_note: Split-half r_SB=0.815 at 300+ pitches (above 0.70 threshold). YoY pooled=0.659. No pair below 0.30 floor.

card_predictive.title: Does it predict results?
card_predictive.what_it_tests: Does Location+ predict BB%, ERA, and xFIP in the same and next season?
card_predictive.direction_note: Negative correlation is correct: higher Location+ = better command = lower BB%, lower ERA, lower xFIP.
card_predictive.s1_improvement_note: S1 baseline adjustment improves BB% correlation from r=−0.590 to r=−0.667.
card_predictive.verdict_note: BB% r=−0.667, xFIP r=−0.313 (concurrent, 2015-2026). Next-season BB% r≈−0.42 (mean over 2021-2026 pairs).

card_independence.title: Is it its own thing?
card_independence.what_it_tests: Does Location+ measure something distinct from pitch shape, delivery, and sequencing?
card_independence.design_note: Features are plate_x, plate_z, count, pitch_type, stand — explicitly no movement, no release point, no sequential context. By construction it cannot re-derive Stuff+, Deception+, or Tunneling+.
card_independence.verdict_note: Feature set deliberately excludes all pitch-quality inputs. Cross-model independence verified by feature set.

card_stress.title: Count-specific RV fix
card_stress.what_it_tests: Whether the count-specific run-value table actually matters and is correctly implemented.
card_stress.rv_variation: 7.8x variation in called-strike run value across counts (0-0 vs 3-2).
card_stress.s1_delta: S1 baseline adjustment improves BB% correlation from r=−0.590 (S0) to r=−0.667 (S1).
card_stress.verdict_note: Count-specific RV corrects core v2 defect. S1 adopted (R2_mix=0.338 ≥ 0.10 threshold). No shrinkage (r_SB@300=0.815 ≥ 0.70).

card_repeatability.title: Does it repeat?
card_repeatability.what_it_tests: Whether pitch-sequence scores are stable year-to-year.
card_repeatability.lower_than_stuff_note: Lower YoY stability than Stuff+ is expected — sequencing is partly a strategic choice, not purely a fixed physical trait.
card_repeatability.verdict_note: YoY r²=0.31–0.53, split-half reliability 0.85–0.91. Stable enough to meaningfully rank pitchers.

card_predictive.title: Does it predict results?
card_predictive.what_it_tests: Does Tunneling+ (old v3 model) predict 2025 outcomes from 2024 scores?
card_predictive.note: These figures are from the old v3 single-regressor, not the current live v2. v2 predictive validity not yet stored as a separate artifact.
card_predictive.direction_note: Positive ERA correlation is correct: higher Tunneling+ = better = lower ERA.
card_predictive.verdict_note: v2 ERA r=0.182, xFIP r=0.337 (concurrent, sign-flip fixed). v3 out-of-sample figures small and mixed. Geometry adds little beyond pitch-type sequencing per 2026-09-21 test.

card_independence.title: Is it its own thing?
card_independence.what_it_tests: Correlation with other models; geometry-leakage test.

geometry_leakage_test.finding: Geometry features (commit/plate/shape distances) show no independent predictive signal for real whiff rates. Model power comes from pitch-type sequencing, not geometric measurement.

card_independence.verdict_note: Low cross-model correlations (r≈0.07–0.15) confirm genuine distinctness. But the geometry features that motivated the model add no independent signal beyond pitch-type sequencing.

card_stress.title: Stress test
card_stress.what_it_tests: Sequential same-at-bat test (old v3 model): do predicted-bad pitches actually produce fewer whiffs?
card_stress.z_score_note: NOT directly comparable to v1 (z=9.06) or v2 (z=9.3-10.0) at face value - see sequential_same_at_bat_test()'s own docstring for exactly what changed and why.
card_stress.verdict_note: The z=84.7 result (old v3 model) was not circular but the corrected test shows geometry features add nothing; sequencing matters but not via the geometry the model was designed around.

card_repeatability.title: Does it repeat?
card_repeatability.what_it_tests: Whether delivery-mechanics scores are stable year-to-year.
card_repeatability.verdict_note: Split-half reliability 0.846 (within-season). YoY r²=0.17–0.34 is the weakest of the four models. Likely cause: arm_angle and release_pos_z (r=0.79 leaguewide) partially capture pitcher identity, not deception mechanics.

card_predictive.title: Does it predict results?
card_predictive.what_it_tests: Concurrent correlation between Deception+ 2026 and same-season outcomes.
card_predictive.direction_note: Negative xwoba correlation is correct. Positive whiff/SwStr/K-BB% correlations are correct.
card_predictive.out_of_sample_note: Strict 2024→2025 out-of-sample test for Deception+ v2 shows small and inconsistent correlations (xwoba r=-0.057, whiff% r=-0.106 — note sign flip on whiff vs concurrent). This gap is unresolved.
card_predictive.out_of_sample_source: models/deception_plus_v1_report_2025.json (separate file for 2025 season scoring; Methodology/HANDOFF.md notes the model)
card_predictive.verdict_note: Concurrent correlations real (xwoba r=-0.536 including Stuff+ overlap). After removing Stuff+ overlap: xwoba partial r=-0.357 still meaningful. But out-of-sample figures are small and mixed.

card_independence.title: Is it its own thing?
card_independence.what_it_tests: Correlation with Stuff+ after mechanics features were moved off Stuff+.
card_independence.mechanics_separation_note: Stuff+ v3 removed release_extension, release_pos_x_as, release_pos_z, arm_angle (confirmed 2026-09-21). These four are now Deception+-exclusive.
card_independence.verdict_note: Stuff+ correlation 0.396–0.470 is moderate and expected. The four mechanics features are separated. But arm_angle × release_pos_z collinearity (r=0.79) means the model may partially proxy pitcher identity or body size.

card_stress.title: Stress test
card_stress.what_it_tests: Height/weight ablation: does removing body-size features change the score?
card_stress.height_weight_ablation_note: Not yet run as a stored artifact. The current model includes height_in and weight_lb; whether removing them degrades or improves out-of-sample performance is unresolved.
card_stress.verdict_note: height/weight ablation not yet run. arm_angle × release_pos_z collinearity (r=0.79) unresolved. A computer-vision pipeline is in R&D to replace these proxy features with timing and concealment measures.

v1_drop_season_corr.note: Drop season feature: corr with baseline. Classified underpowered — diff within noise.

v1_drop_season_next_xfip_diff.note: Difference in next-season xFIP correlation vs baseline. Positive = V1 worse.

haa_corr_with_vchosen.note: Score correlation between model without and with haa_residual. Below 0.9985 = load-bearing.

cf_season_zeroed_corr.note: Season feature zeroed: pitch-level score corr with baseline. < 0.995 = load-bearing.

card_ablation.verdict_note: Ablation was underpowered (30% holdout, 5 folds): no drop variant was convincingly worse. All three features retained by default. haa_residual is load-bearing (r=0.26 when zeroed), with leakage checks passing. Counterfactual scoring confirms all three candidates carry information. Counterfactual scoring is not a refit.

yoy_insample_pooled_mean_r.note: Consecutive season pairs excluding 2020. Final live model scored all seasons.
yoy_insample_pooled_mean_r.basis: in-sample (live model trained on all seasons including scored ones)

yoy_season_holdout_cv.label: Season-holdout CV YoY not run for v4. Ablation used 5-fold 30% pitcher subset — not directly comparable to full-season holdout.

yoy_pitcher_holdout_lopo.label: Pitcher-holdout (LOPO) YoY not run for v4. v3 LOPO r=0.558 from diagnostics/stuff_memorization/memorization_report.json section_A.

split_half_r_at_50.note: Raw split-half r at n=50 pitches

reliability_0_7_n.note: SB reliability already 0.994 at n=50; 0.7 threshold reached below tested minimum.

reliability_0_8_n.note: SB reliability already 0.994 at n=50; 0.8 threshold reached below tested minimum.

card_repeatability.verdict_note: In-sample YoY pooled mean r=0.817 across consecutive season pairs. Split-half reliability (Spearman-Brown) exceeds 0.99 at n=50 pitches. Pitcher-holdout (LOPO) not run for v4; season-holdout YoY not run. v3 LOPO r=0.558 is the honest historical figure — see Notes.

concurrent_xfip_r.note: Same-season xFIP correlation. Negative = higher Stuff+ → lower xFIP (correct sign).
concurrent_xfip_r.basis: in-sample (live model trained on all seasons including these)

concurrent_era_r.note: Same-season ERA correlation. Negative is correct sign.

next_xfip_r.note: Next-season xFIP correlation (consecutive pairs excl. 2020, ≥300 pitches both seasons).
next_xfip_r.basis: in-sample (final model scored all seasons; true holdout would require excluding target season from training)

incremental_delta_r2_xfip.note: Incremental R² of Stuff+ over last-season xFIP for next-season xFIP. Negative = does not add over xFIP.
incremental_delta_r2_xfip.basis: in-sample; simple R² comparison, not multivariate regression (needs improvement)

card_predictive.verdict_note: Same-season: xFIP r=−0.445, ERA r=−0.361 (correct sign). Next-season: xFIP r=−0.225 vs pre-registered bar of ≤−0.30 — bar not met. Incremental delta-R² negative. Both are in-sample (model trained on all seasons). r=−0.225 is meaningful and correctly signed; bar was aspirational.

card_learning.seed_stability_note: NOT_RUN — could not verify > 0.99 formally. Proxy evidence is consistent with passing.

seed_stability_proxy.note: Split-half r at n=50 as proxy for seed stability ≥ 0.99.

sensitivity_2020_vs_2019.note: Score correlation when 2020 is relabeled as 2019.

sensitivity_2020_vs_2021.note: Score correlation when 2020 is relabeled as 2021.

sensitivity_2020_mean_abs_diff.note: Mean abs diff in raw prediction, 2020 vs 2021 relabeling.

kn_mean_score.note: KN below average by construction (limited movement).

cu_mean_score.note: CU averages below 100; noted but expected (slower velo).

identifiability_lopo.label: Pitcher-holdout identifiability probe not run for v4. v3 top-1 lift=0.881 (below 1x = model cannot identify pitchers above chance).

card_learning.verdict_note: All forbidden features absent. HAA leakage checks pass (|r|=0.009 plate_x, 0.084 release_pos_x). 2020 sensitivity scores are highly stable (r>0.94 under label substitutions). Seed stability not formally run (proxy split-half r=0.988 consistent with ≥0.99). Identifiability probe not run for v4.
